```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```

#load data
```{r}
setwd("YOUR DIR")
first_update10 <- readRDS( "first_update10.rds") #created in 5_adjusting_dates.Rmd
total_gdm_deliveries_slimmed_single <-readRDS("total_gdm_deliveries_slimmed_single.rds") #created in 4_pregnancy.Rmd
total_gdm_deliveries_slimmed_multiple <-readRDS("total_gdm_deliveries_slimmed_multiple.rds") #created in 4_pregnancy.Rmd
```


now get there max reg duration (i.e. erliest registration start to latest registration end or prefarably no reg end (i.e. current registration period))

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


cprd_mpsid <- first_update10_multiple_patid %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cprd_mpsid)) %>% 
  distinct(individual_id, cprd_mpsid)

combined_registration <- multiple(first_update10)%>%
  group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    regstartdate = min(regstartdate, na.rm=TRUE),
        regenddate = if(any(is.na(regenddate))) NA_Date_ else max(regenddate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(cprd_mpsid, by = "individual_id")


summary(combined_registration)
```

Now for update 11, remove anyone with a death date prior to the earliest registration

```{r}
first_update11_single_patid <-single(first_update10) %>% 
   filter(death_date>regstartdate|is.na(death_date)) %>% 
  select(patid)

death_dates <- first_update10_multiple_patid %>% 
  distinct(individual_id, death_date)

#obtain valid individuals (who have no death date or a date after their reg)
first_update11_multiple_patid <- combined_registration%>% 
  left_join(death_dates,  by = "individual_id") %>% 
  filter(death_date>regstartdate|is.na(death_date)) %>% 
  distinct(individual_id)

##get total patients remaining
first_update11 <-first_update10 %>% 
  filter(patid %in% first_update11_single_patid$patid|individual_id %in% first_update11_multiple_patid$individual_id)
n_distinct(first_update10_single_patid$patid)+n_distinct(first_update10_multiple_patid$individual_id)

#number of deaths remove
n_distinct(first_update10_multiple_patid$individual_id) -  n_distinct(first_update11_multiple_patid$individual_id)

#number of deaths remove
n_distinct(first_update10_single_patid$patid) -  n_distinct(first_update11_single_patid$patid)

```


For those with multiple patids, need to find the first earliest diagnoses for each individual_id, and then recalcalculate the new ddd.  
```{r}
##1. get earliest issuedate per individual
issuedate_df <- first_update11 %>%
  filter(!is.na(individual_id)) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  slice_min(issuedate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(individual_id, issuedate, productname)

# 2. Get earliest ddd row
ddd_df <- first_update11 %>%
  filter(!is.na(individual_id)) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  slice_min(ddd, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(individual_id, ddd, diagnosis)

# 3. Get earliest admidate row
admidate_df <- first_update11 %>%
  filter(!is.na(individual_id)) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  slice_min(admidate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(individual_id, admidate, HES_term)


# 4. Get earliest gly_date and arrivaldate and pick up gdm and pcos status (needed later)
dates_df <- first_update11 %>%
  filter(!is.na(individual_id)) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>%
  slice_min(gly_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
 select(individual_id, gly_date, gly_term, value)


#now put it all together
first_multiple_patid_combined <- combined_registration %>% 
  filter(individual_id %in% first_update11_multiple_patid$individual_id) %>% #removes those with a death date before registration
  left_join(first_update11%>% select(individual_id, yob, PCOS_GDM_exclude, metformin_exclude, priority_date, min_unequivocal_date, hba1c_date, death_date, gly_num, gdm_status, pattern), by = "individual_id") %>%
  distinct() %>% 
left_join(dates_df, by = "individual_id") %>% 
  left_join(ddd_df, by = "individual_id") %>% 
  left_join(issuedate_df, by = "individual_id") %>% 
  left_join(admidate_df, by = "individual_id")

```

Now update first update 12 put those with single patids with those with multiple patids collapsed to a single line (first_multiple_patid_combined) together and find the earliest date across a row.  This is the new diabetes diagnosis date (ddd)

```{r}
first_update12 <- single(first_update11) %>%
  bind_rows(., first_multiple_patid_combined) %>% 
  mutate(new_ddd = pmin(admidate, issuedate, gly_date, ddd, na.rm = TRUE),
         single_gly_reading = if_else(!is.na(gly_num)&gly_num==1&is.na(ddd)&is.na(issuedate)&is.na(admidate), 1, NA))#log subjects with only a single glycaemic test to evidence DM as will need to be excluded
```


### Update13 - now form the GDM cohort

```{r}
gdm_obs_single <- total_gdm_single_deliveries_slimmed %>% #take all the GDM delivery dates
  left_join(first_update12%>% select(patid, new_ddd), by = "patid") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(new_ddd)) %>% 
  filter(delivery_date<new_ddd %m-% years(1)) %>% 
  group_by(patid) %>% 
  slice_max(delivery_date) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

gdm_obs_multiple <- total_gdm_multiple_deliveries_slimmed %>% 
  left_join(first_update12 %>% select(individual_id, new_ddd), by = "individual_id") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(new_ddd)) %>% 
  filter(delivery_date<new_ddd %m-% years(1)) %>% 
  group_by(individual_id) %>% 
  slice_max(delivery_date) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

```
#now update 13, update the GDM status with the above

```{r}
first_update13 <- first_update12%>% 
  mutate(gdm_status = if_else(patid %in% gdm_obs_single$patid|individual_id %in% gdm_obs_multiple$individual_id, "GDM", gdm_status)) 

table(first_update13$possible_gdm)
```


Now filter down to the actual cohort

```{r}
filtered_cohort <- first_update13 %>% 
  filter(new_ddd>= as.Date("2007-01-01")& (new_ddd<as.Date("2014-01-01"))) %>% #inside entry window only
  filter(new_ddd>=regstartdate+years(1)&(new_ddd<regenddate|is.na(regenddate))) %>%  #at least one year of registration, and diagnosis before regend IF there is a regend
  filter(is.na(PCOS_GDM_exclude)) %>% #not flagged for exclusion based on greater likelihood of PCOS and GDM 
  filter(is.na(metformin_exclude)) %>% #not flagged for exclusion based on having metformin only as evidence of DM
  filter(is.na(single_gly_reading)) %>% #not flagged for exclusion based on having only a single glycaemic test as evidence of DM
  mutate(age_at_diagnosis = year(new_ddd)-yob,   #create age at diagnosis 
         single_script = if_else(pattern=="one-off"&is.na(admidate)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(gly_date), 1, NA)) %>% #create those with single scripts and no other evidence of DM...
  filter(is.na(single_script)) %>% #... and exclude them
  filter(age_at_diagnosis>=18 & age_at_diagnosis <= 65) %>% # only include those within the right age range
    filter(new_ddd<death_date|is.na(death_date))%>% #exclude those whose death was on the day of diagnosis or before diagnosis
  mutate (glicla = if_else(is.na(gly_date)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(admidate)&pattern=="short term"&(productname=="Gliclazide 40mg tablets"|productname=="Gliclazide 80mg tablets"), 1, NA))%>% #identify those whose only evidence of DM is a short course of gliclazide...
  filter(is.na(glicla)) %>% #... and exclude them
  filter(is.na(HES_term)|#either the patient doesn't have a HES term...
           HES_term!= "Unspecified diabetes mellitus Without complications"| # or if they do it is not #'unspecified'...
           (!is.na(gly_date)|!is.na(ddd)|!is.na(issuedate)))  # but if it is unspecified, they have to have other evidence of DM


#the GDM cohort
GDM <- filtered_cohort %>% 
  filter(!is.na(gdm_status))

#the possible GDM cohort
possible_gdm <- filtered_cohort %>% 
  filter(!is.na(possible_gdm))

#Now determine the numbers excluded at each step
glicla_exclude <- first_update13 %>% 
  mutate (glicla = if_else(is.na(gly_date)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(admidate)&pattern=="short term"&(productname=="Gliclazide 40mg tablets"|productname=="Gliclazide 80mg tablets"), 1, NA))%>% 
  filter(!is.na(glicla))

#excluded by ambiguous HES code
amb_hes_exclude <- first_update13 %>% 
  filter(HES_term== "Unspecified diabetes mellitus Without complications"&is.na(gly_date)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(issuedate))

#excluded because of insufficient evidence of DM - i.e. all data lost in the filtration process in 5_adjusting_dates.Rmd
    insufficient <- first_update13 %>% 
    filter(is.na(admidate)&is.na(issuedate)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(gly_date)) 

    #excluded because they had PCOS and GDM but no diabetes coding from the dm_code list and only had insulin and metformin as evidence of DM
    PCOS_GDM_exclude <- first_update13 %>% 
      filter(!is.na(PCOS_GDM_exclude))
  
    #excluded as only evidence of DM was metformin  
    metformin_exclude <- first_update13 %>% 
      filter(!is.na(metformin_exclude))
  
    #excluded because only evidence of DM was a single script  
    single_script <- first_update13 %>% 
       mutate(single_script = if_else(pattern=="one-off"&is.na(admidate)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(gly_date), 1, NA)) %>% 
      filter(!is.na(single_script))
  
    #excluded because only evidence of DM was a single lgycaemic test  
    single_gly_exclude <- first_update13 %>% 
    filter(is.na(admidate)&is.na(issuedate)&is.na(ddd)&!is.na(single_gly_reading))
    
  #total of patients with insufficient data for the CONSORT diagram
      total_insufficient <- first_update13 %>% 
             mutate(single_script = if_else(pattern=="one-off"&is.na(admidate)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(gly_date), 1, NA)) %>% 
    filter((is.na(admidate)&is.na(issuedate)&is.na(ddd)&is.na(gly_date))|
             !is.na(metformin_exclude)|
             !is.na(single_script)|
             !is.na(PCOS_GDM_exclude)| 
             gdm_status=="GDM exclude")
      
    #excluded as outside age range
    age_exclude <- first_update13 %>% 
        mutate(age_at_diagnosis = year(new_ddd)-yob) %>% 
      filter(age_at_diagnosis<18 | age_at_diagnosis > 65)

#excluded as diagnosed outside window    
    outside_window <- first_update13%>% 
        filter(new_ddd> as.Date("2007-01-01")| new_ddd>=as.Date("2014-01-01")) 
    
    #excluded as registered either within or prior to the registration start or after the registration end
    reg_outisde <- first_update13 %>% 
      filter(new_ddd<regstartdate %m+% years(1)|new_ddd>regenddate) 
    
    #excluded because they died on or before day of diagnosis
    death_before_diagnosis <- first_update13 %>% 
      filter(death_date<=new_ddd)
       
```
